reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that monitors and displays API account balance with configurable polling, so notifications-monitoring is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示 API 账户余额和可用状态，并支持手动或按自定义间隔刷新。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek API account balance and availability in the Harness web interface with manual or configurable-interval refreshes.

capabilities: Resolves the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY through the host credentials service
Makes read-only network requests to the DeepSeek balance endpoint
Displays account balance and availability in the web interface
Refreshes balance data on a configurable schedule and stores refresh preferences in localStorage
